'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**[[Azerbaijan]] says that 2,783 [[Azerbaijani soldier]]s were killed during the [[Second Nagorno-Karabakh War|2020 Nagorno-Karabakh war]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/3/azerbaijan-says-2783-soldiers-killed-in-nagorno-karabakh-clashes (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mali Civil War]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] announces that 300 troops will be [[Military deployment|deploy]]ed to [[Mali]] as part of the [[United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali|MINUSMA]] [[peacekeeping]] mission. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2020/dec/03/uk-starts-deployment-of-300-troops-to-mali-as-part-of-un-mission-minusma (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2020 California wildfires]]
**A wildfire breaks out in [[Orange County, California|Orange County]], [[California]], U.S., and spreads to over 2,000 [[acre]]s, prompting evacuations. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2020-12-03/photos-intense-brush-fire-in-orange-county-prompts-evacuations (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[Avonmouth explosion]]
**Four people are killed and another injured by an explosion at a [[wastewater treatment]] works in [[Avonmouth]], [[Bristol]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-bristol-55173667 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[California]] [[Governor of California|Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] introduces a regional [[stay-at-home order]] that requires the closure of bars, wineries, hair salons, and barbershops for three weeks in regions where [[Intensive care unit|ICU]] capacity falls below 15% and also restricts non-essential travel in those regions. The order divides the state into five regions. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/california-covid-stay-at-home-order-2020-12-03/ (CBS News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Dakota]]
*****[[North Dakota]] [[North Dakota Legislative Assembly|lawmakers]] issue a [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] for their upcoming [[North Dakota Legislative Assembly|legislative season]] at the [[North Dakota State Capitol|state capitol]]. The measure will take effect on January 5. [https://www.grandforksherald.com/news/government-and-politics/6786524-North-Dakota-lawmakers-pass-mask-rule-for-Legislature-despite-outcry-from-far-right-members (''Grand Forks Herald'')] [https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/north-dakota/articles/2020-12-03/north-dakota-legislature-votes-to-require-masks-at-capitol (U.S. News & World Report)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iowa]]
*****[[Governor of Iowa|Iowa Governor]] [[Kim Reynolds]] says that the [[Iowa|state]] is expected to receive up to 172,000 [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] doses this month. [https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/news/politics/2020/12/03/iowa-gov-kim-reynolds-holds-covid-19-news-conference-after-cdc-vaccine-vote/3802147001/ (''Des Moines Register'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vermont]]
*****The number of new confirmed cases in [[Vermont]] increases by a record 178 cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the total of confirmed cases to 4,642. [https://www.vpr.org/post/vermont-sets-yet-another-record-178-new-covid-19-cases#stream/0 (Vermont Public Radio)]
****[[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]] announces that Dr. [[Vivek Murthy]] and [[Jeff Zients]] will lead [[Presidency of Joe Biden|his administration]]'s response to the COVID-19 pandemic. He has also asked Dr. [[Anthony Fauci]] to remain in the [[White House Coronavirus Task Force]] and become its chief medical advisor. [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/12/03/zients-murthy-biden-coronavirus-team-442609 (Politico)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Alberta]] reports 1,854 new cases, a single-day record. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/alberta-coronavirus-covid-19-deena-hinshaw-1.5826900 (CBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Premier of Quebec|Quebec Premier]] [[François Legault]] cancels a plan to allow [[Christmas]] gatherings of up to 10 people in the [[Quebec|province]] amid an increase of cases. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/article-quebec-government-cancels-plan-to-allow-christmas-gatherings-as-covid/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****The [[Government of Greece|government]] extends the nationwide [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] by one week until December 14 to reduce the spread of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/259854/article/ekathimerini/news/greece-extends-lockdown-to-december-14-as-viral-load-persists (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a record 993 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 58,038 and surpassing the previous record of 919 new deaths recorded on March 27. [https://www.corriere.it/salute/20_dicembre_03/coronavirus-italia-bollettino-oggi-3-dicembre-23225-nuovi-casi-993-morti-7a22b104-355e-11eb-bd9c-afff1b18009e.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]
****[[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] signs a decree that bans inter-regional travel between December 21 and January 6 except for work, health, or emergency reasons. In addition, people will not be allowed to leave their towns on [[Christmas Day]], [[Boxing Day]], and [[New Year's Day]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/03/italy-bans-travel-between-towns-over-christmas (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55175735 (BBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] reports a record 182 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 5,324. [https://hungarytoday.hu/covid-hungary-coronavirus-thursday-record-fatalities-new-cases/ (Hungary Today)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[Russia]] increases by a record 28,145 cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2,375,546. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/12/03/russia-reports-record-28k-coronavirus-cases-a72223 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] surpasses 60,000 total deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-55176614 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[Indonesia]] increases by a record 8,369 new cases over the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 557,877. [[Papua (province)|Papua]] reports the most cases of any province with 1,755 new cases. [https://nasional.okezone.com/read/2020/12/03/337/2321072/rekor-kasus-covid-19-di-papua-tertinggi-disusul-jabar-dan-jakarta (Okezone)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] surpasses one million total cases of COVID-19. [https://www.bloomberg.com/amp/news/articles/2020-12-03/iran-s-covid-19-cases-surpass-1-million-since-start-of-pandemic (Bloomberg)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
***[[President of Chile|President]] [[Sebastián Piñera]] extends the [[state of emergency|state of catastrophe]] for another three months until March 13, 2021 due to the ongoing pandemic. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/chile-re-extends-coronavirus-related-state-of-1104069.html (''UrduPoint'')]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Moderna]] says that they are expected to have 100–125 million doses of their vaccine shipped globally during the first quarter of [[2021]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-moderna/moderna-to-supply-up-to-125-million-covid-19-vaccine-doses-globally-in-first-quarter-idUSKBN28D3FA (Reuters)]
***[[Sinovac]] delivers one million doses of [[CoronaVac]] to [[Butantan Institute]] in [[São Paulo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-vaccine-brazil/brazil-gets-chinese-covid-19-vaccine-doses-senate-oks-british-vaccine-funding-idUSKBN28D1MX (Reuters)]
*[[2020 H5N8 outbreak]]
**[[South Korea]] reports a new case of highly pathogenic [[avian influenza]] [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N8|H5N8]] in [[bird|wild bird]]s in [[Buan County|Buan]], [[North Jeolla Province]] according to the [[Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (South Korea)|Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs]]. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201203003100320 (Yonhap News Agency)]

'''International relations'''
*[[North Macedonia–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[North Macedonia]] and the [[United Kingdom]] sign a Partnership, Trade and Cooperation Agreement to continue preferential trade terms after the end of the UK's [[Brexit]] transition period on December 31. The agreement also strengthens political, economic, security, and cultural ties between both nations. [https://www.gov.uk/government/news/north-macedonia-and-uk-sign-partnership-trade-and-cooperation-agreement (Gov.uk)]
*[[Nauru–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] and [[Nauru]] sign a trade deal which is expected to provide access to the full range of investment support offered by the United States to the Pacific Island nation. Nauru High Commissioner Michael Aroi thanked [[Joseph Cella]], the U.S. Ambassador to several Pacific Island nations, for continuing American support to boost relations between both countries. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/432095/nauru-high-commissioner-to-fiji-michael-aroi-signs-trade-deal-with-us-ambassador-joseph-cella-in-fiji (RNZ)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020–2021 United States racial unrest]]
**[[Kenosha unrest shooting]]
***The [[Kenosha County, Wisconsin|Kenosha County]] Circuit Court orders [[Kyle Rittenhouse]], the 17-year-old teen accused of shooting three people, two fatally, during protests in [[Kenosha, Wisconsin|Kenosha]], [[Wisconsin]], to stand trial for first degree homicide and reckless [[endangerment]]. His lawyers are claiming he did so in [[self defense]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/teen-suspect-kyle-rittenhouse-stand-trial-charges-shooting/story?id=74518909 (ABC News)] 
*[[2020 Hong Kong national security law|Hong Kong national security law]], [[Pro-democracy camp (Hong Kong)]]
**[[Hong Kong]] [[media of Hong Kong|media]] tycoon and [[pro-democracy]] activist [[Jimmy Lai]] is denied bail and remains in custody over alleged fraud related to the lease of a building that houses his ''[[Apple Daily]]'', an anti-government newspaper. [https://www.reuters.com/article/hongkong-security-jimmylai/hong-kong-media-tycoon-jimmy-lai-in-custody-after-fraud-charge-idUSP8N2BE02A (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Facebook]] announces that it will remove misinformation related to [[COVID-19 vaccine]]s as countries prepare to distribute them. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/12/03/facebook-to-remove-misinformation-about-coronavirus-vaccines.html (CNBC)]
*[[Chinese space program]]
**The [[China National Space Administration]] probe [[Chang'e 5]] lifts off from the surface of the [[moon]] as it begins a journey back to [[Earth]] after collecting samples of [[lunar soil]]. The ascender will rendezvous with the [[orbiter]], transferring over the samples, and the orbiter will then land at a location in [[Inner Mongolia]], [[China]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-55179983 (BBC News)]
